accuracy: Rotations reproduce pygplates within 0.36 km after 16-bit rounding. Rotations are one model's reconstruction; beyond each plate's last pole the rotation file holds the pole constant.
adaptations: Plate model: the 503 polygon outlines stored at their 0 Ma positions with coordinates rounded to 16 bits; the rotation of each of the 241 plates at each map's time and one million years earlier, as 16-bit quaternions; the 2 line features in the polygon file left out.

accuracy: Made with Natural Earth. Today's coastlines at 1:50 million scale.
adaptations: Coastlines split into 2121 pieces where they cross a plate outline and given the plate they lie on; coordinates rounded to 16 bits. The first 300 populated places by scalerank and population, names with runs of spaces collapsed, each given the plate it lies on.
